thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Las Olas Boulevard — dining/shopping spine; transfer from port required — ~120 min.
Fort Lauderdale Beach — A1A corridor; transfer Not verified in minutes.
Riverwalk / downtown museums — short call option if traffic cooperates.
Hugh Taylor Birch / Anne Kolb nature — longer buffer.
Everglades airboat (organised) — only with firm return margin.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Confirm the exact terminal number on your cruise documents before instructing a rideshare — Port Everglades spreads guests across eight separately addressed buildings.
